data.name: pnlAutoNexus.ToolTip
data.value:
Automatically attempt to bring your character to Nexus in the event your HP would fall below a certain amount
It will predictively track the damage your character takes in order to calculate your HP and determine if you should be sent to the Nexus
It is not guaranteed! YOU CAN STILL DIE NO MATTER WHAT! We recommend 15% or more!

data.name: chkAutoNexusUseClientHp.ToolTip
data.value: Client HP is predictive autonexus. Recent RotMG updates have made this much less accurate, such as the healing buff being wisdom based, it is now very hard to determine your healing, among a few other changes.
